patientSummary:
Dear Syn,

Thank you for attending your comprehensive examination today. We identified an occlusal carious lesion on tooth #46 and have restored it with a composite filling. The tooth feels comfortable and you reported that it feels much better.

Please continue your regular oral hygiene routine – brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste and floss daily. If you notice any new pain, sensitivity, or a change in the restoration, give us a call.

We look forward to seeing you at your next scheduled recall.

Kind regards,
Your Dental Team
